SUPERSEDES.REASON: Independent reviews found remaining determinism/authority gaps in derived identities, reference types, semantic coverage, dependency resolution, acceptance criteria derivation, decision/polarity validity and complete hash-domain typing.

PRIMARY_SPEC.LOGICAL_FILENAME: แอป [NEXY-IGNIS] ที่กำลังพัฒนา.docx

MATRIX_EXPORT.FORMAT: UTF-8 parsed-text export containing CSV sheets

PARAGRAPH_INDEX_CONTRACT.AUTHORITY_COMPARISON_RULE: All temporal/authority comparisons use transformed one-based primary DOCX paragraph numbers, never raw matrix paragraph numbers.

NORMALIZATION_CONTRACT.CSV_PARSER: RFC4180-compatible quoting for comma-separated rows; doubled quote escapes; quoted commas/newlines preserved
NORMALIZATION_CONTRACT.BUILD_MATRIX_EXTRACTION: Read only the first sheet named Build Matrix from MATRIX_EXPORT, from its exact header through the row before the next <PARSED TEXT FOR SHEET marker.
NORMALIZATION_CONTRACT.STRING_RULE: Decode CSV cell, normalize Unicode NFC, preserve non-empty content exactly including leading/trailing whitespace; do not semantic-trim.
NORMALIZATION_CONTRACT.EMPTY_CELL_RULE: An empty decoded CSV cell becomes JSON null. Nullable fields are always present with null; keys are never omitted.
NORMALIZATION_CONTRACT.INTEGER_RULE: index, Source_Doc_Paragraph and Source_Extraction_Seq are base-10 JSON integers; non-integer or missing values are invalid.
NORMALIZATION_CONTRACT.BOOLEAN_RULE: Schema booleans are JSON true/false only.
NORMALIZATION_CONTRACT.SET_ARRAY_RULE: Set-like arrays are deduplicated then sorted by UTF-8 byte ordering of their canonical string representation.
NORMALIZATION_CONTRACT.REFERENCE_ARRAY_RULE: Primary-source reference arrays sort by paragraph_1_based ascending, then anchor UTF-8 bytes.
NORMALIZATION_CONTRACT.ENTRY_SORT_RULE: Root entries sort by source_entry_id UTF-8 bytes; duplicate source_entry_id is invalid.
NORMALIZATION_CONTRACT.JCS_RULE: Apply RFC8785/JCS only after this normalization contract.
NORMALIZATION_CONTRACT.SELF_REFERENCE_RULE: ROOT_HASH is stored outside ROOT_OBJECT and never hashed into itself.

SOURCE_ENUMERATION_ROOT_HASH.PURPOSE: Exhaustive normalized source-material identity; never the active-build denominator.
SOURCE_ENUMERATION_ROOT_HASH.MATRIX_ROW_INCLUSION: All 837 Build Matrix rows must appear exactly once.
SOURCE_ENUMERATION_ROOT_HASH.PRIMARY_OMISSION_RULE: Create PRIMARY_FINAL_DOC_C_OMISSION entries only from COVERED_OMISSION decisions in the bound complete coverage-decision manifest. source_entry_id MUST use DERIVED_IDENTITY_CONTRACT; no fuzzy or ad-hoc omission creation is allowed.
SOURCE_ENUMERATION_ROOT_HASH.COVERAGE_GATE: Bound final-DOC-C obligation enumeration unresolved_count MUST equal 0; bound coverage-decision unresolved_count MUST equal 0; primary_final_doc_c_coverage_unmatched_count MUST equal 0; every COVERED_OMISSION decision must materialize exactly one matching omission entry.
FORBIDDEN_SHORTCUTS: 837 structurally valid matrix rows do not prove exhaustive final DOC-C coverage when known primary omissions exist.
Do not treat workbook declared SHA256 as the byte hash of MATRIX_EXPORT.
Do not use source enumeration as active-build authority or implementation proof.

AUTHORITY_RECONCILIATION_ROOT_HASH.PURPOSE: Complete authority decision manifest covering every source-enumeration entry exactly once.
AUTHORITY_RECONCILIATION_ROOT_HASH.ACTIVE_AUTHORITY_RULE: Every ACTIVE decision MUST contain at least one final_doc_c_normative_refs_1_based reference within primary paragraphs 9886..10499. Document class labels alone never confer build authority.
AUTHORITY_RECONCILIATION_ROOT_HASH.NEGATIVE_OBLIGATION_RULE: Final DOC-C MUST_NOT/non-goal requirements are ACTIVE_FINAL_DOC_C_NEGATIVE with polarity PROHIBIT and remain in the active-build denominator.
AUTHORITY_RECONCILIATION_ROOT_HASH.DOC_B_RULE: DOC-B may constrain interpretation but cannot independently create an active-build obligation without a final DOC-C normative incorporation reference.
AUTHORITY_RECONCILIATION_ROOT_HASH.DOC_D_RULE: DOC-D may provide supporting design detail but cannot independently create an active-build obligation; active use requires explicit final DOC-C normative incorporation.
AUTHORITY_RECONCILIATION_ROOT_HASH.HISTORICAL_RULE: Pre-FINAL historical rows cannot become ACTIVE without explicit final DOC-C normative incorporation evidence.
AUTHORITY_RECONCILIATION_ROOT_HASH.COMPLETENESS_RULE: entry_count MUST equal SOURCE_ENUMERATION entry_count, source_entry_id sets MUST be identical, unresolved_count MUST equal count(CONFLICT|UNKNOWN) plus count(invalid decision/polarity pairs).
AUTHORITY_RECONCILIATION_ROOT_HASH.ROOT_FIELD_TYPES: Use ROOT_TYPE_CONTRACTS.COMMON plus exact hash/string fields declared by this schema.
AUTHORITY_RECONCILIATION_ROOT_HASH.DECISION_POLARITY_RULE: Every entry MUST satisfy DECISION_POLARITY_MATRIX exactly; invalid pairs are schema errors and increment unresolved_count.

ACTIVE_BUILD_REQUIREMENT_ROOT_HASH.PURPOSE: Stable immutable denominator of current positive and negative build obligations.

ENTRY_TYPE_CONTRACT.polarity: REQUIRE|PROHIBIT and equal to bound reconciliation polarity
ENTRY_TYPE_CONTRACT.requirement: non-empty NFC string copied from bound source/reconciliation authority
ENTRY_TYPE_CONTRACT.final_doc_c_normative_refs_1_based: non-empty array PRIMARY_DOCX_REF identical to bound reconciliation
ENTRY_TYPE_CONTRACT.supporting_refs: sorted array of EVIDENCE_REF; empty allowed
ENTRY_TYPE_CONTRACT.dependencies_identity: sorted unique array source_entry_id strings copied exactly from bound dependency-resolution root
ENTRY_TYPE_CONTRACT.validation_acceptance_criteria: non-empty array CRITERION_OBJECT copied exactly from bound acceptance-criteria derivation root

ACTIVE_BUILD_REQUIREMENT_ROOT_HASH.INCLUSION_RULE: Include exactly reconciliation entries with ACTIVE_FINAL_DOC_C_POSITIVE or ACTIVE_FINAL_DOC_C_NEGATIVE after all bound subordinate roots are RESOLVED.
ACTIVE_BUILD_REQUIREMENT_ROOT_HASH.AUTHORITY_RULE: Each entry must retain the same final DOC-C normative refs and polarity proven by the bound reconciliation root.
ACTIVE_BUILD_REQUIREMENT_ROOT_HASH.STABILITY_RULE: Mutable implementation/accounting states are forbidden from this denominator root.
ACTIVE_BUILD_REQUIREMENT_ROOT_HASH.MUTABLE_ACCOUNTING_LOCATION: Requirement accounting is maintained in separate versioned ledgers/evidence and is evaluated against this stable denominator during closure.
ACTIVE_BUILD_REQUIREMENT_ROOT_HASH.MUST_NOT_VERIFICATION_RULE: PROHIBIT obligations require positive evidence that forbidden capability/behavior is absent or unreachable; omission from implementation is not self-proving.
FORBIDDEN_SHORTCUTS: Do not include DOC-B, DOC-D, supplements, or historical rows solely from source labels.
Do not omit final DOC-C negative obligations.
Do not materialize if reconciliation, coverage, dependency resolution, or acceptance-criteria derivation has unresolved_count > 0.
Do not use the legacy current-ish aggregate of 773 rows as this denominator.
Do not synthesize obligation_id, dependency IDs or acceptance criteria outside their bound deterministic contracts.

DEPLOYMENT_EVIDENCE_REQUIREMENT_ROOT_HAS.PURPOSE: Stable denominator of DOC-E deployment/runtime proof obligations, separate from implementation.
DEPLOYMENT_EVIDENCE_REQUIREMENT_ROOT_HAS.INCLUSION_RULE: Include exactly reconciliation entries classified DEPLOYMENT_EVIDENCE_ONLY with valid DOC-E primary refs and RESOLVED acceptance-criteria derivation.
DEPLOYMENT_EVIDENCE_REQUIREMENT_ROOT_HAS.SEPARATION_RULE: Deployment evidence cannot satisfy, replace, or increase ACTIVE_BUILD_REQUIREMENT_ROOT obligations.
DEPLOYMENT_EVIDENCE_REQUIREMENT_ROOT_HAS.STABILITY_RULE: Mutable evidence status is forbidden from this denominator root and is tracked separately.

CURRENT_MATRIX_SCOPE_COUNTS.LEGACY_CURRENT_ISH_AGGREGATE_773: 12 + 547 + 127 + 87; this is not the literal CURRENT_BUILD count and is not an authority denominator.

GLOBAL_VALIDATION_GATES: Final DOC-C obligation enumeration completeness and both independent raw-Spec reviews must PASS.
Coverage-decision manifest must cover every primary final-DOC-C obligation exactly once with unresolved_count=0.
Source enumeration coverage gate must be zero unmatched and omission identities must recompute exactly.
Source enumeration and reconciliation source_entry_id sets must be identical.
Every reconciliation decision/polarity pair must satisfy DECISION_POLARITY_MATRIX.
Every active-build entry must bind final DOC-C normative authority.
Every final DOC-C MUST_NOT/non-goal must be represented as a PROHIBIT obligation.
Dependency-resolution root must be complete with unresolved_count=0 and active entries must copy its resolved IDs exactly.
Acceptance-criteria derivation root must be complete with unresolved_count=0 and denominator entries must copy criteria exactly.
All derived IDs must independently recompute from their domain-separated identity objects.
All reference/evidence objects must pass exact type, duplicate and canonical sort rules.
No mutable accounting/evidence status appears in denominator roots.
All root objects and subordinate manifests pass normalization and independent JCS/SHA-256 recomputation.

DERIVED_IDENTITY_CONTRACT.COLLISION_RULE: If one derived ID resolves to more than one distinct canonical identity object, materialization fails closed as HASH_IDENTITY_COLLISION.

FIELD_TYPES.anchor: non-empty NFC string preserving exact authoritative anchor text

PRIMARY_DOCX_REF.SORT: paragraph_1_based ascending, then anchor UTF-8 bytes
PRIMARY_DOCX_REF.DUPLICATE_RULE: Exact duplicate objects are invalid; deduplication by semantic guess is forbidden.

FIELD_TYPES.evidence_kind: non-empty NFC string from schema-specific enum
FIELD_TYPES.source_id: non-empty NFC logical source identifier or normalized repository path
FIELD_TYPES.anchor: non-empty NFC string locating the evidence

EVIDENCE_REF.SORT: evidence_kind UTF-8, source_id UTF-8, source_hash_alg UTF-8, source_hash UTF-8, anchor UTF-8

REFERENCE_OBJECT_CONTRACT.ARRAY_RULE: Every hash-bearing reference array is a set-like array: validate element type, reject exact duplicates, then sort by its declared tuple before JCS.

FINAL_DOC_C_OBLIGATION_ENUMERATION_ROOT_.COMPLETENESS_RULE: Enumerate every atomic normative obligation in locked primary DOC-C paragraphs 9886..10499 exactly once. Ambiguous atomicity or authority produces an unresolved entry; unresolved_count MUST be zero before downstream roots materialize.
FINAL_DOC_C_OBLIGATION_ENUMERATION_ROOT_.REVIEW_GATE: At least two independent raw-Spec reviews must attest the exact enumeration root; neither reviewer may be the enumeration author.

ENTRY_TYPES.primary_obligation_id: existing DOC-C derived ID from bound enumeration root
ENTRY_TYPES.matrix_source_entry_ids: sorted array of source_entry_id strings; nonempty only for COVERED_MATRIX
ENTRY_TYPES.omission_source_entry_id: OMIT- derived ID for COVERED_OMISSION; null otherwise

COVERAGE_DECISION_MANIFEST_ROOT_HASH.MATRIX_MATCH_RULE: Coverage is not inferred from labels, fuzzy similarity, or source class. Each primary obligation receives one explicit reviewed coverage decision binding exact primary refs and exact matrix row IDs.
COVERAGE_DECISION_MANIFEST_ROOT_HASH.ONE_TO_MANY_RULE: One primary obligation may map to multiple matrix rows only when the coverage decision proves those rows jointly represent that exact obligation.
COVERAGE_DECISION_MANIFEST_ROOT_HASH.MANY_TO_ONE_RULE: One matrix row may cover multiple primary obligations only through distinct reviewed decisions that each cite the same row and prove the mapping.
COVERAGE_DECISION_MANIFEST_ROOT_HASH.AMBIGUITY_RULE: CONFLICT or UNKNOWN increments unresolved_count and blocks source-enumeration readiness.
COVERAGE_DECISION_MANIFEST_ROOT_HASH.REVIEW_GATE: Every coverage decision must have independent review bound to the exact primary obligation and matrix row blob identities.

DECISION_POLARITY_MATRIX.VALIDATION_RULE: Any reconciliation decision/polarity pair outside this exact matrix is invalid and makes unresolved_count nonzero.

ENTRY_TYPES.dependencies_source_text: exact normalized source text or null
ENTRY_TYPES.resolved_source_entry_ids: sorted unique array of existing active source_entry_id strings
ENTRY_TYPES.evidence_refs: array of EVIDENCE_REF; nonempty for RESOLVED/CONFLICT

DEPENDENCY_RESOLUTION_ROOT_HASH.EMPTY_RULE: null dependencies_source_text requires NO_DEPENDENCIES and an empty resolved_source_entry_ids array.
DEPENDENCY_RESOLUTION_ROOT_HASH.RESOLUTION_RULE: Do not parse free text heuristically into IDs. Any non-null dependency relation requires an explicit reviewed mapping to exact source_entry_id values.
DEPENDENCY_RESOLUTION_ROOT_HASH.COMPLETENESS_RULE: Exactly one entry for every active reconciliation source_entry_id.

FIELD_TYPES.criterion_id: AC- + lowercase 64-hex SHA-256 of JCS({domain,source_entry_id,text,authority_refs}) with domain NEXY_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERION_ID_V1

ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA_DERIVATION_ROOT_HASH.AUTHORITY_RULE: Criterion text is never free-form implementation advice. It must be justified by exact locked-Spec authority refs and independently reviewed against those refs.
ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA_DERIVATION_ROOT_HASH.COMPLETENESS_RULE: Exactly one entry for every reconciliation source_entry_id that will enter ACTIVE_BUILD or DEPLOYMENT_EVIDENCE denominator.

COMMON.domain: non-empty NFC string fixed by schema
COMMON.entries: JSON array sorted by schema-declared key

RECONCILIATION_ENTRY.final_doc_c_normative_refs_1_based: array PRIMARY_DOCX_REF; nonempty for ACTIVE decisions

DEPLOYMENT_ENTRY.validation_acceptance_criteria: non-empty array CRITERION_OBJECT copied exactly from bound acceptance-criteria root
